**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind projected need fields to their actual supporting claims**

`_accepted_version` only verifies the interpretation status and evidence hash; it does not verify that the assessment still names this project/activity or that the source was admitted. Historical `NeedObservation` links remain after reassignment, and supplemental news is also linked, so `/api/projects/{id}/state` can label the current tier, MW, timing, duration, and supply as supported by evidence that belongs to another project or does not establish those fields. Apply the current project/activity/admission predicates and retain field-specific provenance rather than assigning every accepted linked evidence row to every need field.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/1b186a49615174444eca82250466608610f03937/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)

+"""Read-only, evidence-version-bound current state for one project."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import defaultdict
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlalchemy import select
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from gridlens.intelligence.buying_chain import _accepted_version, buying_chain_view
+from gridlens.intelligence.lifecycle_service import lifecycle_event_supported
+from gridlens.persistence.models import (
+    Evidence,
+    Interpretation,
+    LifecycleEvent,
+    NeedObservation,
+    Observation,
+    PowerNeed,
+    Project,
+    ProjectLifecycle,
+    ProjectMatchDecision,
+)
+
+
+def _provenance(evidence: Evidence) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "id": str(evidence.id),
+        "url": evidence.url,
+        "extraction_location": evidence.extraction_location,
+        "source_date": evidence.event_date or evidence.published_at,
+        "retrieved_at": evidence.observed_at,
+        "support": "accepted interpretation",
+    }
+
+
+def _unknown() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"value": None, "status": "UNKNOWN"}
+
+
+def _supported(value: Any, evidence: list[Evidence]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return (
+        {"value": value, "status": "SUPPORTED", "evidence": [_provenance(e) for e in evidence]}
+        if evidence
+        else _unknown()
+    )
+
+
+def _conflict(values: list[tuple[Any, Evidence]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not values:
+        return _unknown()
+    if len({str(value) for value, _ in values}) == 1:
+        return _supported(values[-1][0], [values[-1][1]])
+    return {
+        "value": None,
+        "status": "CONFLICT",
+        "claims": [
+            {"value": value, "evidence": _provenance(evidence)} for value, evidence in values
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def _accepted_need_evidence(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> dict[UUID, list[Evidence]]:
+    rows = session.execute(
+        select(NeedObservation.need_id, Evidence, Interpretation)
+        .join(Observation, Observation.id == NeedObservation.observation_id)
+        .join(Evidence, Evidence.observation_id == Observation.id)
+        .join(Interpretation, Interpretation.observation_id == Observation.id)
+        .join(PowerNeed, PowerNeed.id == NeedObservation.need_id)
+        .where(PowerNeed.project_id == project_id)
+        .order_by(Evidence.observed_at, Evidence.id)
+    ).all()
+    result: dict[UUID, list[Evidence]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for need_id, evidence, interpretation in rows:
+        if _accepted_version(interpretation, evidence):
+            result[need_id].append(evidence)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retain unaffected claims when one run input is superseded**

When an enrichment run combines multiple documents, superseding or rejecting any one retained input marks the entire run non-current. Claims supported exclusively by the other still-current documents are then removed because only `active_run.claim_ids` are selected; if no older run contains those newer claims, valid buyer and contractor evidence disappears and can generate a false material-removal event. Validate the selected claims against their own citations instead of invalidating the whole run because one unrelated input changed.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/1b186a49615174444eca82250466608610f03937/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)
